title: Functional Spaces, Furnishing & Reusable Blueprint Assemblies
objective: Implement capability-derived spaces/zones, furnishing/fixture/decor bindings, reusable room/building/site assemblies, requirement explanations, dependency/substitution checks, provenance/versioning and permission-safe placement/review, while consuming canonical owner definitions and staffing/access/environment prerequisites without creating duplicate people, job, inventory, facility, blueprint, or World ledgers.
acceptance: Space and facility capabilities derive from accepted components, networks, access, environment and staffing prerequisites; labels alone grant no capability.
Furnishings, fixtures and decor remain owner-backed Asset/component references with permission-safe placement proposals.
Reusable room/building/site assemblies preserve explicit definitions, dependencies, substitutions, provenance and versions without becoming canonical live instances before owner-authorized commit.
Missing component, network, staffing, access or environment support remains unresolved or unmet rather than inferred from names or visual similarity.
Historical MBES-17 staffing residuals are bindings to Character/MNCS/ODL/DPL/Project owners, not a parallel people/job scheduler.
Placement/review remains semantic/nonvisual and keyboard-capable with provider-off local operation.
boundaries: MBES-01 and MBES-03 remain sealed predecessors.
Inventory/Asset retains live furnishing/fixture/item identity and placement truth.
Character/MNCS, ODL, DPL and Project/Time retain people, staffing, job and schedule truth.
World/Environment owners retain canonical condition truth.
MBES-05 creates no second blueprint, facility, Asset, people, job, staffing, Project, World, environment or provenance ledger.
MBES-08 and later MBES tranches remain unauthorized until canonical MBES-05 closeout.
next_action: Establish causal RED for MBES-05 through the public functional-space/furnishing/blueprint seam, then implement only the bounded capability-derived adapters required by the reduced family contract.

last_material_progress.evidence: Owner Continue governed-started MBES-05 from canonical selected_not_started state.
